files.projects/grove/.locmetryrc:
version = 1
[scope]
hidden = false
respect_ignore_files = true
exclude = ["src/vendor/**"]
[categories]
automation = "Maintained project tools"
[[rules]]
id = "maintained-tools"
match = ["src/tools/**"]
purpose = "production"
category = "automation"

prompt:
You have ./bin/locmetry and synthetic inputs in this scratch directory. Work only here. The executable and its built-in discovery material are your only product documentation; do not read other directories, implementation files, telemetry, or the launcher, and do not use the internet or other agents. You may inspect synthetic inputs and use ordinary shell/Python tools. Do not modify project files or their supplied configuration.

Measure only projects/grove's src/ subtree while retaining the grove root's policy, module context and path identities. Add two command-line exclusions, for src/scratch/** and src/hold/**, in every subtree measurement. First preserve the configured hidden/ignore settings and save complete per-file JSON as outputs/default.json. Then enable hidden content and disable ignore-file filtering, retaining all explicit exclusions, and save complete per-file JSON as outputs/open.json. For this second selection, save a separate human table as outputs/open-table.txt: Production source only, source categories, comment-density bars, name sorting, and adaptive folder detail with a two-row budget. Save an unfiltered Markdown report of the same selection as outputs/open.md, name-sorted with folder depth two. Finally save outputs/subroot-app.json: the complete machine explanation of core/app.js when projects/grove/src itself is the root, without supplying a configuration.

Report source Files/Lines/Code and Code by purpose for both selections. Explain the table versus JSON purpose totals, whether its folder-row budget is a strict cap, why the Markdown folder rows cannot all be added, and what the direct-root app explanation establishes about retained context. Include commands and any unresolved result in a final answer of at most 250 words. Create the requested artifacts, but no assessment document or logging harness.
grading: Recovered mistakes may pass; record recovery cost. Inspect supporting calls and fixture integrity. Missing artifacts, selection checks or requested conclusions are incomplete. Incorrect selected paths/counts, claims that table purpose filtering changes saved JSON, a strict folder-row cap, additive recursive Markdown, ancestor config discovery or invented retained module evidence are critical failures. Oracle counts are hand-calculated from the simple physical files; rendered examples or documentation figures are not the oracle.
